bibl.title: Scribal Harmonization in the Synoptic Gospels

series.title: New Testament Tools, Studies and Documents

bibl.seg: Cambry G. Pardee, Scribal Harmonization in the Synoptic Gospels = New Testament Tools, Studies and Documents. 60.
Leiden - Boston, Brill, 2019, xiv-494 pp. ISBN 978-90-04-39180-2. €160.
C.R. par Matthew Burks, TC: A Journal of Biblical Textual Criticism 24 (2019) 5 pp. < http://jbtc.org/v24/TC-2019-Pardee-Burks.pdf >. - James W. Barker, JThS 72 (2021) pp. 392-394.
bibl.note: Scribal harmonization. - Fragmentary manuscripts of the second and third centuries. - Extensive manuscripts of the third century. - Fragmentary manuscripts of the fourth century. - Codex Vaticanus: a fourth-century manuscript with the complete text of the Synoptic Gospels. - Codex Sinaiticus: a fourth-century manuscript with the complete text of the Synoptic Gospels. - Conclusion: harmonization and Gospel harmony. - Bibliography. Indexes.
